name: Gifford Pinchot State Park
winter_2026_27: campground closed late October 2026 to mid-April 2027 (DCNR); ReserveAmerica's 2027 park season starts 2027-04-01
winter_loops: All campsite loops closed to camping and vehicles in winter. Only the modern cabins stay open year-round (not RV sites).
season_note: Winter 2026-27: the campground is closed from late October to mid-April; only the modern cabins are open in winter. From 2027 the shower houses are renovated in phases, and the affected sites are blocked on the booking system.
sources: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-parks/find-a-park/gifford-pinchot-state-park/stay ('The campground opens in mid-April and closes in late October.') + https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-parks/find-a-park/gifford-pinchot-state-park/winter ('the network of spur roads and trails in the interior of the park campground, which are closed to camping and vehicle use during the winter season' / 'Year round overnight opportunitunities are available at the modern cabins.') + https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/gifford-pinchot-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880306 ('Park Season Start Thu Apr 01 2027 End Sun Oct 31 2027'; 'Status: Open year round.' refers to the park; 'Beginning in 2027, the campground at Gifford Pinchot State Park is undergoing a major shower house renovation project. During this time, portions of the campground will be temporarily closed while other areas remain open as work is completed in phases... The sites which are impacted during this phased project are blocked for reservations on our system.'), read 2026-11-07
weak_spots: The opening date conflicts: DCNR says mid-April, but ReserveAmerica's park season starts Apr 1 2027 (that may be the cabin/park season, not the campsites). The stored 04-15/10-31 is approximate ('mid-April'/'late October'). The exact 2026 closing date was not published; I did not page ReserveAmerica's campsite calendar beyond its first 25 rows (cottages/day use/group areas, all X in mid-November). The 2027 shower-house project is a partial closure, so it belongs in a note, not status.

name: North Creek Campground
winter_2026_27: open until 'late November' 2026, reopens 'mid-March' 2027 (no exact dates published)
winter_loops: Single FCFS campground (single sites + one double site); no loop-level winter detail published.
winter_limits: Drinking water may be off when temperatures are near or below freezing; vault toilets; first-come only, pay at kiosk (cash/check).
season_note: Winter 2026-27: open until late November, reopening mid-March (no exact dates published). Drinking water may be shut off in freezing weather.
sources: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/north-creek-campground ('Site Open'; 'Seasons of Use: Mid-March - late-November'; 'Open Mid-March to Late November'; 'To preserve infrastructure, drinking water may not be available when the average temperatures are near or below freezing.'; last updated March 24, 2026) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/availability/campground/10158505/month (Scan & Pay placeholder, 1 site, 'Not Reservable' every night Nov 2026-Apr 2027: no information), read 2026-11-07
weak_spots: 'Late November' has no exact date, so the campground may close anywhere around Nov 20-30 and the part-of-winter window could be only days. The Scan & Pay calendar carries no season information. The district office (540-291-2188) was not called.

name: Scotchtown Draft dispersed camping area
winter_2026_27: no seasonal closure published; dispersed camping allowed year-round under GWJ rules; access roads are VDOT state routes, and no road closure applies to them as of 2026-11-07
winter_loops: Dispersed roadside sites along Scotchtown Draft Road (SR 627) / Indian Draft Road (SR 678); no loops.
winter_limits: No facilities (no water, toilets or trash); 14 days in any 30; Scotchtown Draft Road is unpaved and may be rough or unplowed in snow; the general rule also says to camp 100 ft from streams.
season_note: Winter 2026-27: Forest Service dispersed camping has no season, and the access roads are state routes rather than gated forest roads. No facilities; the dirt road may be rough or unplowed after snow.
sources: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/camping-cabins ('Recreationist can camp anywhere in the National Forest outside a designated campground.' / 'Dispersed camping in one location is allowable up to 14 days in any 30-day period.' No seasonal limit stated) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/alerts (current alerts list: James River & Warm Springs RD closures cover FSR 465, FSR 342 Little Mountain Rd to 11/15/2026 and FSR 125 Skyline Drive to Jan 1 2027; nothing on SR 627/SR 678 or the Scotchtown Draft area) + OpenStreetMap (Overpass, 2026-11-07) tags the access roads as 'Scotchtown Draft Road SR 627' and 'Indian Draft Road SR 678', read 2026-11-07
weak_spots: Inferred from the forest-wide dispersed rules plus the lack of any road order; no page names this area. That the roads are state routes comes from OSM, not an agency source. I did not read the Warm Springs/North River MVUM, and I did not confirm which ranger district manages the area. VDOT winter plowing of SR 627 (dirt) is unknown.

name: McClintic Point Primitive Campground
winter_2026_27: closed after Labor Day weekend 2026 until April 2027 (no exact dates published)
winter_loops: All closed. On recreation.gov only the 2 group sites have inventory from 2027-03-05; the 21 FCFS single sites read 'Not Reservable', which carries no information.
season_note: Winter 2026-27: closed from after Labor Day weekend until April. Seasonal drinking water runs April to October; vault toilets are open only while the campground is open.
sources: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/mcclintic-point-campground ('Seasons of Use: April - Labor Day Weekend'; 'Restrooms are available when the site is open for the season'; last updated April 15, 2025) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234558 ('seasonal drinking water, which is available April through October') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/availability/campground/234558/month (Nov 2026-Feb 2027: no availability rows for any of 23 sites; Mar 5-7 2027 group sites 'Available', Mar 8-20 'Open', singles 'Not Reservable'), read 2026-11-07
weak_spots: The USFS page was last updated 2025-04-15 (not 2026). The rec.gov water text (April-October) runs past the Labor Day close. The group sites show bookable from 2027-03-05, which is earlier than 'April'; that may be a booking-calendar setting, not an opening.

name: Hone Quarry Campground
winter_loops: Single small FCFS campground; no winter loop closures published.
winter_limits: No potable water at any season; vault toilets; first-come only ($5).
season_note: Winter 2026-27: open all winter, first-come; no drinking water at any time of year, vault toilets only.
sources: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/hone-quarry-campground ('Site Open'; 'Seasons of Use: Open year round'; 'Potable water is not available at this site.'; last updated April 13, 2026) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/availability/campground/10158490/month (Scan & Pay placeholder with no availability rows: no information), read 2026-11-07
weak_spots: No published statement on winter plowing of FDR 62 (1.7 mi forest road); no current alert closes it.

name: North River Campground
winter_2026_27: open until 'late December' 2026, reopens 'early March' 2027 (no exact dates published)
winter_loops: Single FCFS campground of 9 sites; no loop-level detail.
winter_limits: No potable water at any season; vault toilets; first-come only ($5).
season_note: Winter 2026-27: open until late December, reopening early March (no exact dates published). No drinking water at any time; vault toilets only.
sources: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/north-river-campground ('Site Open'; 'Seasons of Use: early-March - late-December'; 'Open Season: Early-March to Late-December'; 'Potable water is not available at this site.'; last updated May 1, 2025), read 2026-11-07
weak_spots: The page was last updated 2025-05-01. No exact dates. Access is over FDR 96/95/958; there is no alert on them, but winter road condition is not published. Not on recreation.gov.

name: Elizabeth Furnace Family Campground
winter_loops: The 32-site family campground is open year-round (FCFS); the separate 2-site group camp is reservation-only and has no water.
winter_limits: Winter (Nov-Apr): showers, flush toilets and hydrant water off; vault toilets and a hand pump near the entrance year-round; $10/night winter vs $20 May-Oct; first-come, pay by Scan & Pay or cash/check at the Iron Ranger.
season_note: Winter 2026-27: open all winter, first-come, at the $10 winter rate. Showers, flush toilets and hydrants run only May to October; vault toilets and a hand pump by the entrance stay open all year.
sources: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/elizabeth-furnace-recreation-area ('Campground and Day Use open year-round with limited amenities during the winter months.'; 'Flush toilets and showers are only available from May – October. Vault toilets open year-round'; 'Potable water is available at this site at Hydrants and in the shower house from May to October. Hand Pump available year round.'; '$20 per site per night during the summer months and $10 per site during the winter'; last updated May 20, 2026) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10158475 ('Sites are currently $10/night with limited services and $20/night when water systems are running (May-October)') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/availability/campground/10158475/month (33 sites 'Not Reservable' every night Nov 2026-Apr 2027, a few Scan & Pay 'Reserved' nights in early Nov 2026), read 2026-11-07
weak_spots: The calendar's 'Not Reservable' reflects FCFS and proves nothing either way; the 'Reserved' Scan & Pay nights on Nov 1-3 and 6 2026 show campers there now. No site-level winter closures published.

name: Bolar Mountain Recreation Area
winter_2026_27: closed after Labor Day 2026 until Memorial Day weekend 2027
winter_loops: All three loops closed (Sugar Ridge / Campground 1 and the others). recreation.gov has no inventory for any of 124 sites Nov 2026-Apr 2027.
season_note: Winter 2026-27: closed from after Labor Day until Memorial Day weekend. Construction of the new wastewater plant limited 2026 to first-come camping in Sugar Ridge with portable toilets; no 2027 plan is posted yet.
sources: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/bolar-mountain-recreation-area ('Seasons of Use: Memorial Day Weekend - Labor Day Holiday'; 'We are currently replacing the Bolar Mountain Wastewater Treatment Plant, and construction will impact recreation offerings during the 2026 season. Sugar Ridge Campground (Campground 1) will open for first-come, first-served camping beginning May 15, 2026.'; last updated March 25, 2026) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/availability/campground/234557/month (Nov 2026-Apr 2027: no availability rows for any of 124 sites), read 2026-11-07
weak_spots: It is unknown whether the wastewater construction carries into 2027; the page speaks only of the 2026 season. The Twin Ridge Road closure alert ended 2026-09-22.

name: Seven Points - Raystown Lake
winter_2026_27: closed after the night of 2026-10-25; reopens 2027-04-02 (recreation.gov calendar)
winter_loops: All loops closed in winter. On 2027-04-02 PCAM, RCAM, SENO, MCAM and the Seven Points (PA) loop open; BCAM, SENO (UP) and VCAM (70 sites) read 'Closed' all of April 2027.
season_note: Winter 2026-27: closed from late October (last night Oct 25) to April 2 2027, when most loops reopen; loops B, V and upper SENO stay closed through April 2027.
sources: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/availability/campground/233626/month (last 'Reserved' night 2026-10-25; 2026-10-28 to 2027-04-01 70 sites 'Not Available', the rest no rows; first 'Available' 2027-04-02; BCAM/SENO (UP)/VCAM 'Closed' all April 2027) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233626 ('All sites are available by advanced reservation. There are NO "first come first serve" walk in sites.'), read 2026-11-07
weak_spots: The USACE Raystown page (nab.usace.army.mil) answered 403 and was not read, so no operator season text was read; the dates come from the booking calendar only. The 2026 close and 2027 open are calendar edges (the Oct 25 close sits within the window-artifact band, but nights Oct 26-27 had no rows). Aggregators say early April to late October. No recurring season published.

name: Susquehannock - Raystown Lake
winter_2026_27: closed after Labor Day weekend 2026 (last night 2026-09-06); no inventory until 2027-05-28 (Memorial Day weekend, Not Yet Released)
winter_loops: Whole campground (64 sites) closed; no availability rows at all from 2026-09-07 through 2027-05-27.
season_note: Winter 2026-27: closed from after Labor Day weekend until Memorial Day weekend 2027.
sources: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/availability/campground/233644/month (last 'Reserved' night 2026-09-06; no rows 2026-09-07 to 2027-05-27; 2027-05-28..31 'NYR' for 61 sites), read 2026-11-07
weak_spots: The USACE Raystown page answered 403 and was not read. A Memorial Day to Labor Day season is inferred from the calendar edges; a news lead (Yahoo) says it typically opens Memorial Day weekend. No operator season text was read.
